# Blast radius before depth

`customer_support.pb.ticket_triage.blast_radius_before_depth` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Establish breadth before depth: one user, one account, one segment, or everyone.

Depth is what the reporter can see and describe. Breadth is what turns a ticket into an incident, and it is invisible from inside a single ticket unless triage deliberately goes looking for the second report.
